auth.title: Sign in with email

auth.codeSent: Enter the six-digit code sent to {email}.

auth.privacy: LabViz does not use a password for this first release.

home.title: Turn experiment data into a clear figure.
home.subtitle: Upload a spreadsheet, review data-quality findings, and create a paper-ready chart through one guided workflow.
home.dropBody: Excel, CSV, TSV, TXT, or JSON · up to 50 MB on the website
home.sampleChooserDescription: Every example is synthetic and works offline. Open one to see which table shape fits each visualization.
home.sampleSyntheticNotice: These values are synthetic teaching data. They are processed through the same workflow as an uploaded file.
home.sampleCatalogError: The example catalog could not be loaded. You can still choose a local file.
home.experimentTitleRequired: Enter an experiment name before adding run, replicate, or batch details.
home.privacyBody: The original file is not retained as a project asset. Project previews and findings come from the LabViz API running on this computer.
home.workflowTitle: From raw data to a figure in four steps
home.stepImportBody: Review sheets, headers, fields, and units before analysis.
home.stepInspectBody: See why a value is suspicious and choose what happens to it.
home.stepChartBody: Choose the chart type, axes, fitting, uncertainty, and panel layout.
home.stepExportBody: Prepare PNG, SVG, or PDF with scientific dimensions and DPI.
home.invalidType: Choose an Excel, CSV, TSV, TXT, or JSON file.
home.tooLarge: This website accepts files up to 50 MB. Split the file or use a smaller export.
home.readError: The selected file could not be read. Your source file was not changed.

workspace.startFileDescription: The selected file is kept only for this browser session unless you explicitly save the project.
workspace.loadFailed: The processing service could not load this project. Your source file was not changed.
workspace.loadingUploadDescription: Your file is being sent to the LabViz API on this computer for processing.
workspace.loadingQueueDescription: Your file is queued and will begin processing shortly.
workspace.loadingParseDescription: LabViz is detecting worksheets, headers, and usable data fields.
workspace.loadingProfileDescription: LabViz is profiling missing, conflicting, and suspicious values.
workspace.loadingDefaultDescription: The data preview will appear as soon as processing is complete.

importData.title: Confirm your data
importData.description: Check the detected sheet, header, columns, and units before quality inspection.
importData.loadingDescription: The preview will appear after the processing service confirms the workbook structure.
importData.noNumericColumns: No numeric columns were detected. Choose a different sheet or header row, or correct the source file before creating a chart.
importData.contextualTip: If the preview looks wrong, try a different worksheet or move the header row before continuing.

inspect.title: Review data quality
inspect.description: LabViz highlights possible issues and explains them. Nothing is changed automatically.
inspect.missingBody: One measurement is empty. Excluding it from this chart preserves the source file.
inspect.suspiciousBody: This value is far from nearby measurements. Review it before choosing an action.
inspect.representativeRows: The table highlights {count} representative row references; the affected count includes the complete dataset.
inspect.loadingDescription: LabViz is waiting for the processing service to return validated data-quality findings.
inspect.sourceUnchanged: The source file remains unchanged. Only project decisions affect the cleaned copy and chart.
inspect.decisionHelp: Keep preserves the point, Exclude hides it only from analysis and charts, and Remove omits every matching row from the cleaned copy. You can undo any choice.
inspect.rangeDescription: Values outside this range are only flagged for review. Applying a rule resets earlier decisions because the finding list changes.
inspect.rangeFailed: The valid range could not be applied.
inspect.filterTitle: Filter and jump to an issue

missing.summary: {count, plural, one {# missing value} other {# missing values}}
missing.reason: These cells are empty. LabViz will not replace or remove them without your decision.

typeConflict.summary: {count, plural, one {# value does not match the numeric column} other {# values do not match the numeric column}}
typeConflict.reason: Most values in this column are numeric, but these cells contain other text.

duplicate.summary: {count, plural, one {# row belongs to a duplicate group} other {# rows belong to duplicate groups}}
duplicate.reason: These rows repeat all values. Confirm whether repetition is expected before removing a cleaned copy.

outsideRange.summary: {count, plural, one {# value is} other {# values are}} outside the valid range
outsideRange.reasonBoth: You defined {minimum} to {maximum} as valid for this column. LabViz has only flagged the values for your review.
outsideRange.reasonMinimum: You defined at least {minimum} as valid for this column. LabViz has only flagged the values for your review.
outsideRange.reasonMaximum: You defined at most {maximum} as valid for this column. LabViz has only flagged the values for your review.

extremeValue.summary: {count, plural, one {# value is} other {# values are}} far from the middle range
extremeValue.reason: These values fall beyond 1.5 interquartile ranges. This is a review flag, not proof that the measurements are wrong.

suddenChange.summary: {count, plural, one {# point changes abruptly from the previous row} other {# points change abruptly from the previous row}}
suddenChange.reason: The adjacent change is much larger than the typical change in this column. Review the measurements before excluding anything.
suddenChange.gridSummary: {count, plural, one {# point changes abruptly from neighboring grid coordinates} other {# points change abruptly from neighboring grid coordinates}}
suddenChange.gridReason: The change between neighboring grid coordinates is much larger than the typical grid change. Review the measurements before excluding anything.

trendInconsistent.summary: {count, plural, one {# point differs} other {# points differ}} from the overall trend
trendInconsistent.reason: A strong linear trend was present across row order (R²={rSquared}), and these residuals were unusually large. This is a review flag, not proof that the measurements are wrong.

inspect.affectedRows: {count, plural, one {# affected row} other {# affected rows}}
inspect.decisionSaveFailed: The cleaning decision could not be saved.
inspect.noMatchDescription: No issue matches the selected status and type.
inspect.noIssuesDescription: No missing, duplicate, conflicting, or suspicious values were reported.

chart.title: Create your chart
chart.description: Choose the chart, analysis, axes, and layout the experiment needs. Scientific calculations come from the Python service.
chart.loadingBody: The chart will render after the API returns a validated preview.
chart.sampled: Preview uses {count} evenly distributed rows from {total} total rows.
chart.saveFailed: The chart settings could not be saved.
chart.surfaceSetupDescription: Select X and Y as the two grid coordinates, then select Z as the measured response. The preview will appear after all three fields are different.
chart.surfaceAxisHelp: X and Y locate each point on the grid. Z is the measured value whose height and color form the surface.
chart.dataTableTitle: View the chart data as a table
chart.dataTableDescription: Use the table as a non-visual alternative to the chart. Highlighted cells correspond to quality findings in the current preview.

surfaceDiagnostics.invalidValues: The surface has {count} non-finite point(s). Fix or remove those rows.
surfaceDiagnostics.insufficientPoints: A surface needs at least three complete points and two unique X and Y values.
surfaceDiagnostics.collinear: The selected X and Y coordinates are collinear. Choose a grid spanning both dimensions.
surfaceDiagnostics.duplicateCoordinates: The selected X/Y coordinates contain {count} duplicate row(s). Keep one Z value per pair.
surfaceDiagnostics.missingGrid: The selected X/Y coordinates are missing {count} grid cell(s). Provide a complete rectangular grid.
surfaceDiagnostics.irregularGrid: The X and Y coordinates are not uniformly spaced. Use a regular grid or a scatter plot.

recommendations.surfaceGridLine: A complete {xCount} × {yCount} grid with {pointCount} points was detected. A line chart would connect repeated {xField} values across {yField} slices. Choose a 3D surface with X={xField}, Y={yField}, and Z={zField}.
recommendations.surfaceGrid: A complete {xCount} × {yCount} grid with {pointCount} points was detected. A 3D surface can show {zField} over {xField} and {yField}.
recommendations.scatterGrid: These coordinates are incomplete, duplicated, or irregular. Use a scatter plot to inspect individual {zField} measurements without implying a complete surface.

chart.analysisHelp: Fitting estimates a trend from the selected points. Uncertainty shows measurement spread or a supplied error column; choose only options supported by your experiment design.
chart.contextualTip: Choose X and Y from the numeric fields first. For a surface, use separate X, Y, and Z fields and keep the grid complete.
chart.groupHelp: Grouping draws separate series for categories or repeated conditions without changing the measurements.
chart.weightedFitHelp: Weighted least squares requires the error-bar option to use an existing error column whose values represent measurement standard deviation.
chart.robustFitHelp: Huber robust fitting is limited to linear models. It reduces the influence of large residuals, does not show a confidence band, and does not make biased data valid.
chart.calculatingAnalysis: The Python service is calculating the fitted curve and uncertainty preview.
chart.analysisFailed: Scientific analysis could not be calculated for these fields.
chart.residualTrend: Residuals may still have a trend; the selected model may miss structure.
chart.deferredMethods: Deferred in this release: multiplicity correction across series or groups.

evidenceMessages.modelForm: The selected model form is appropriate for the scientific question.
evidenceMessages.completeObservations: Complete finite observations are representative of the intended analysis set.
evidenceMessages.errorColumn: The supplied error column is proportional to measurement standard deviation.
evidenceMessages.bootstrap: Bootstrap residual resampling is reasonable for the included observations.
evidenceMessages.confidence: The selected confidence level is interpreted as a pointwise mean interval.
evidenceMessages.residualDescriptive: Residual summaries are descriptive checks on the response scale.
evidenceMessages.residualNoInference: They do not establish independence, normality, or causality.
evidenceMessages.rSquared: R² describes in-sample association and does not establish causality.
evidenceMessages.pointwise: The interval is pointwise for the fitted mean and is not a prediction interval or a simultaneous confidence band.
evidenceMessages.ordinary: Ordinary least squares gives every included observation equal weight.
evidenceMessages.weighted: Weighted fitting uses the supplied error column; it is not a robust estimator.
evidenceMessages.robustAssumption: Huber IRLS uses a fixed tuning constant of 1.345 and the standardized X scale for a linear design.
evidenceMessages.robustLimit: Huber downweights large residuals but does not make biased, confounded, or poorly designed data valid.
evidenceMessages.predictionAssumption: The interval includes residual variation for one future response under the selected linear or polynomial model.
evidenceMessages.simultaneousAssumption: The Working-Hotelling band covers the family of fitted mean values represented by the displayed linear or polynomial curve.
evidenceMessages.predictionConfidence: The selected confidence level is interpreted for one future response.
evidenceMessages.simultaneousConfidence: The selected confidence level is interpreted as a Working-Hotelling simultaneous mean band.
evidenceMessages.predictionLimit: This prediction interval includes estimated residual variation and is not a simultaneous confidence band.
evidenceMessages.simultaneousLimit: This simultaneous mean band is not a prediction interval.
evidenceMessages.residualTrend: A possible residual trend suggests the selected model may miss structure.
evidenceMessages.prediction: A prediction interval was not requested; a pointwise mean interval is a different estimand.
evidenceMessages.simultaneous: A simultaneous confidence band was not requested; it is not interchangeable with a pointwise or prediction interval.
evidenceMessages.robust: Huber robust fitting was not requested; it does not make biased or poorly designed data valid.
evidenceMessages.multiplicity: No multiplicity correction is applied across series or groups.
evidenceMessages.weightedSelection: Select weighted least squares only when an error column is scientifically justified.
evidenceMessages.confidenceRequiresFit: A confidence band is available only when a supported fit is selected.
evidenceMessages.residualRequiresFit: Residual diagnostics require a successfully fitted curve.
evidenceMessages.fitUnavailable: The selected fit could not be calculated for this analysis.

chart.singlePanelType: This chart type uses one publication panel. Choose line, scatter, bar, histogram, or box plot for multi-panel figures.
chart.continueOnDesktop: Mobile supports review and simple edits. Continue on a desktop for fitting, dual axes, and multi-panel layout.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose interface, figure, export, privacy, and storage defaults.
settings.appearanceDescription: Use the operating-system setting or choose a light/dark theme. This preference stays in this browser.
settings.interfaceLanguageDescription: The interface language does not replace text already entered in a figure.
settings.figureLanguageDescription: Titles, axes, legends, and exported text remain independently selectable.
settings.fontDescription: Applied when a new figure is created; existing projects keep their saved font.
settings.figureSizeDescription: Applied to new figures; custom width and height remain adjustable in Export.
settings.resolutionDescription: Publication size units and raster resolution used for each new figure.
settings.grayscaleDescription: Preview whether colors and line styles remain distinguishable in print.
settings.localHistoryDescription: Future Windows builds keep compressed project copies in the application directory.
settings.retentionDescription: Guest files are temporary. Originals are deleted after parsing and results expire after two hours of inactivity.
settings.cloudDescription: Projects are retained locally only after you explicitly choose Save locally.
settings.cleanupDescription: Available in the future Windows application. This website does not claim to delete local desktop data.
settings.saved: Defaults saved in this browser and ready for the next figure.
settings.defaultsNote: These browser defaults are applied when you start a new figure.

shared.noDescription: The creator did not add a description.
shared.disabled: The creator has disabled downloads for this link.

help.title: Help and scientific guidance
help.description: Plain-language guidance for the complete first-chart workflow.
help.noMatchDescription: Try a broader phrase such as confidence interval, sampling, or original file.
help.workflowTitle: How an upload becomes a chart
help.workflowDescription: Every local upload follows the same inspectable path. The browser configures the chart; the Python service performs the data work.
help.exportNote: PNG, SVG, and PDF are generated independently by the Python backend from the validated chart specification. The publication export does not reuse a screenshot of the browser.
help.tipsTitle: Small tips at the decision points

tips.import: For a workbook, choose the measurement sheet and confirm the header row before re-importing.
tips.inspect: Keep is not the same as Remove: Exclude affects analysis and charts; Remove affects the cleaned copy too.
tips.chart: Use numeric X/Y/Z fields for quantitative charts. A regular rectangular grid is required for a 3D surface.
tips.export: Use 300 DPI for most manuscripts and 600 DPI when the journal or line detail requires it.
tips.privacy: Feedback is prepared locally and contains no source rows, chart values, filenames, email addresses, or project IDs.

help.tipsReset: Tips will appear again when you reach a decision point.
help.feedbackDescription: Create a privacy-safe diagnostic note without an account. Copy or save it offline, or open a prefilled GitHub issue only after you review the external-site warning.
help.feedbackDescriptionLabel: What happened or what would help?
help.feedbackDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the problem or idea without pasting experiment rows or private identifiers.
help.feedbackPrivacy: Only the app version, operating-system/browser class, generic screen name, feedback type, and your description are included.
help.savedFeedback: Diagnostic saved as a local text file.
help.externalWarning: GitHub is an external website. Review the diagnostic text before opening it. Continue?

common.noPreviewDescription: The service returned column metadata but no preview rows.
common.surfaceUnavailableDescription: The optional WebGL renderer could not be loaded. The Python service can still validate and export the 3D figure.
common.lowCostFallback: A lower-cost view is active for this device; the preview is sampled and the complete data remains available for analysis and export.
common.surfaceGestureHint: Touch the surface with one finger to rotate; pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Use the buttons to reset or when gestures are difficult.
